reviews.text: Brilliant with my cat, thank you!
Thank you so much Sophie for doing such a good job on my extremely furious Persian who hates being groomed.
Best grooming place we've ever been to. They're amazing with Luis and he always looks super smart afterwards. ❤️

Been going to Foxy Groomers for almost 2 years now and I just love Sophie and Kana and how they treat my cat Stormy 😍

My boy is a bit of a shy cat and oftentimes a bit nervous when he has to leave our home, but they always make sure he's happy and keep a close eye on his wellbeing, which is so reassuring and important. They would never proceed if the animal's health would suffer, which just speaks volumes to how much they love cats and dogs.

They always do an amazing job on his long fur and I couldn't be happier. The atmosphere is so pleasant for cats as well as dogs, at this point it feels like I'm visiting friends with my cat.
Strongly recommend coming here for your pet's grooming needs :)
Sophie is so good with Bernie, we continue to visit after moving to south London.
Maudie absolutely loves going to Sophie, she’s just the best in the area!

Hi Darren, thank you for taking the time to leave a review.
